displayOrder.name: Initiative Outline
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality PokeTaskBar macOS desktop INITIATIVES page. Attached image 1 is the now-approved inline Issues layout; image 2 is the approved Projects List layout; image 3 is its approved alternate Grid layout. Use these actual images as the visual system references. Carry the same native shell, typography, spacing, icon language, compact metadata and inset panels to Initiatives.
Target 1488 x 1056, landscape straight-on complete application window. Current date Friday 18 September 2026 if a date is visible. Single product screen, no presentation titles, numbers, annotations or external browser frame.
Preserve expanded left navigation around 240px: PokeTaskBar identity, Cody, Search, Today, Focus, Issues, Projects, Initiatives, Collection, Usage, Settings at bottom. Initiatives is selected. Native traffic lights, back/forward controls, compact Initiatives tab, left and right sidebar collapse buttons. Independently collapsible/resizable navigation left and optional extras right.
Continuous #EFF0F2 shell, pale #F8F8FA main rounded canvas inset with visible gutters on every edge including bottom, discrete white supporting surfaces only where grouping helps. Primary text #242528, metadata #73757B, modest blue status accents, neutral selected fill, dark primary buttons. SF Pro-like 14-16pt readable rows and restrained 28-32pt heading, consistent small outline icons. NO permanent sidebar separator strokes, full-height rules, edge-to-edge section dividers or grip dots. Hover-only resize guides are invisible at rest. Use spacing and alignment. Avoid boxing every row.
Initiatives connect a broader purpose to its projects and then to actionable issues. Preserve Active / Planned tabs, owner, target date, status, description, issue access and Open in Linear. A compact Find an initiative field helps browse. Small quiet refresh text Synced just now. No New initiative button, AI summaries, health scores, percent complete, Gantt charts, budgets, activity feeds or elaborate management features.
Illustrative data: 3 Active initiatives. 'Focused work' selected, owner Cody, target 31 Oct 2026, purpose 'Make daily work calmer and easier to begin.' It connects projects PokeTaskBar (4 issues) and Focus Assistant (2 issues). PokeTaskBar includes SPA-142 Refine PokeTaskBar navigation; SPA-148 Polish menu-bar controls; SPA-151 Check sidebar resizing; SPA-139 Review focus session notes. Focus Assistant has 2 issues, which can remain collapsed.
Other initiatives 'Everyday tools', owner Cody, target 13 Nov 2026, purpose 'Make everyday capture and notes feel simple.', projects Markdown Notes and Capture Workflow. 'Creative practice', owner Cody, target 30 Nov 2026, purpose 'Keep creative projects moving one step at a time.', project Audio Portfolio.
Do not show a running timer or large Pokémon. Never put Start focus on an initiative itself: the flow is Initiative -> Project -> Issue -> Focus. View projects / Open project / View issues can be navigation actions. A Start focus action may be shown ONLY beside a specific issue with 25 min. Essential project and issue access stays in main content even when the optional right rail closes. This is a focused exploration, not a feature inventory. All mock dates derive from 18 September 2026. No clipped content or tiny decorative type.
Direction: Initiative Outline.
Continue the expandable Projects List approach in a wide main canvas with the optional right extras rail open. Header Initiatives, Active 3 / Planned tabs, Find an initiative. Three initiative headings as unboxed disclosure rows. The first 'Focused work' is expanded and has a quiet purpose sentence, target 31 Oct and 2 projects.
Under it, indented project headings 'PokeTaskBar 4 issues' (expanded) and 'Focus Assistant 2 issues' (collapsed). Under PokeTaskBar show ONLY two compact preview issues, SPA-142 and SPA-148, then a quiet 'View all 4 issues' navigation link. The first issue's row can have a small dark Start focus button and 25 min. Structure is legible with indentation, small flag/project/status icons and whitespace, no connecting tree lines and no section rules. Do not crowd extra fields into these rows.
Below the expanded initiative leave a generous gap, then collapsed 'Everyday tools' with 2 projects, and 'Creative practice' with 1 project, each showing target and owner quietly.
Right optional rail contains two small separate rounded surfaces: 'Initiative details' with Status Active, Owner Cody, Target 31 Oct 2026; then 'Purpose' with the selected purpose text and a quiet Open in Linear link. No charts or summary KPI tiles. Preserve the approved window's comfortable gutters and shell. This is a concise navigable hierarchy from purpose to a task, entirely readable.
